text: 'Now run along, and don't get into mischief. I am going out.' Then old Mrs. Rabbit took a basket and her umbrella, and went through the wood to the baker's. She bought a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
title: Page 2: Mrs. Rabbit Walks to the Baker's
director_note: We staged Mrs. Rabbit's departure as a single continuous walk through the wood, moving from a warning pose into a carried walk cycle so her exit feels earned and unhurried. The camera keeps her readable against the layered foliage while the warm path and soft dappled light make the farewell feel like a gentle turning point rather than a chase.
